When searching or booking flights, you may have several questions in mind. To make it easier, we’ve compiled a list of FAQs with all the answers in one place.
How can I check my flight status on Cleartrip?

To check your flight status, visit the Cleartrip website or mobile app and go to the airline-specific PNR status section. Enter your flight details - including flight number, travel date, departure city, and arrival city and click ‘Check Status’. You’ll receive real-time updates on your flight, helping you stay informed and plan your journey with ease.
Does Cleartrip offer refunds on cancelled tickets?
Yes, refunds are processed based on the airline's cancellation policy. Any applicable charges will be deducted.
How do I get the best flight deals on Cleartrip?
You can check ongoing offers, set fare alerts, and book in advance for the cheapest flight tickets.
Can I modify my flight booking?
Yes, you can make flight modifications, such as changing the date or time, subject to airline policies and fees.
What payment methods does Cleartrip accept?
Cleartrip accepts multiple payment methods, including credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and digital wallets.
Is it safe to book flights on Cleartrip?
Absolutely! Cleartrip uses secure encryption technology to protect your flight ticket booking payment and personal details.
Can I select my seat while booking a flight?
Yes, many airlines allow seat selection during booking or after air ticket confirmation.
How will I receive my e-ticket?
Once you confirm your booking, we will send your e-ticket to your email. You can also access it on the Cleartrip app.
What are the benefits of flight booking with Cleartrip?

Booking flights with Cleartrip comes with multiple benefits - competitive fares, exclusive offers like the Travel Max Sale, Big Travel Sale, and Cleartrip Tatkal, plus additional savings with partner bank cards such as ICICI, HDFC, Axis, Kotak, and more. With these deals, you can enjoy low-cost flights and maximize your travel savings.
How do you make flexible flight bookings with changeable dates?

To make flexible flight bookings on Cleartrip, select ‘ClearChoice Plus’ or ‘ClearChoice Max’ before confirming your ticket. These options let you change your travel dates or even switch airlines at a minimal cost, giving you peace of mind if your plans change.
Can I book a flight for someone else on Cleartrip?

Yes, you can book a flight for someone else on Cleartrip. Simply enter the passenger’s correct details, such as their full name and travel dates, at the time of booking. You can also choose to book for a single traveler or the entire family in one go.
What documents do I need for my flight?
For domestic flights, you will need:
A valid government-issued ID such as Aadhaar Card or PAN Card
A copy of your ticket or booking confirmation
The boarding pass for your scheduled flight
Does Cleartrip offer special discounts or promotions on flight bookings?
Yes, Cleartrip offers a variety of deals and discounts on both domestic and international flight bookings.
